question.problem:
What is the solution to the following system of inequalities?

$$
\{\begin{aligned}4x-2>6 \\ 2x-9\le 5\end{aligned}
$$
question.worked_solution:
To solve the system, we need to find the values of $x$ that satisfy both $4x-2>6$ and $2x-9\le 5$ simultaneously.

- First, we solve $4x-2>6\,:$

$$
\begin{aligned}4x-2 & >6 \\ 4x-2+2 & >6+2 \\ 4x & >8 \\ \frac{4x}{4} & >\frac{8}{4} \\ x & >2\end{aligned}
$$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14194110/assets/59523e51144ef776295ec43032def1bc0192351deb6294fbb2d56acd87bb2cac.png)

- Then, we solve $2x-9\le 5\,:$

$$
\begin{aligned}2x-9 & \le 5 \\ 2x-9+9 & \le 5 \\ 2x & \le 14 \\ \frac{2x}{2} & \le \frac{14}{2} \\ x & \le 7\end{aligned}
$$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14194110/assets/b0107bec7ccb2c56036de405a29870e8cfcc166cc6405f425fc3296ec8f1be2b.png)

To find the values of $x$ that satisfy both inequalities, we find where the two solutions overlap:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14194110/assets/f9ace3f6dd9d93b960c61bb31ca3858aefbb0e8d43f2392a643c078ae6111a0d.png)

Thus, the final solution is $2<x\le 7.$
